DEADLY DELUGE: AN IRISH INN MYSTERY (BOOK #1) is the first book in a new cozy mystery series by Fiona Grace, #1 bestselling author of Murder in the Manor, which has over 10,000 five star reviews!

When travel writer Fiona Flynn is handed what sounds like a dream assignment — touring the Irish countryside to review the country's 100 best B&Bs — she doesn't hesitate for a second.

What she doesn't expect is that her first stop will be a remote, rain-soaked village far off the beaten path.

She also doesn't expect to find her host dead.

Fiona, stranded by flooded roads with nowhere to go and no one to trust, and by neighbors who seem to know more than they're saying.

In a village where everyone has a past and old secrets run as deep as the rain, Fiona quickly discovers that getting the story was never supposed to be this literal.

In AN IRISH INN MYSTERY, Fiona Flynn winds her way across the Emerald Isle, reviewing quaint inns and stumbling into murders with equal regularity. Funny, warm, and completely addictive, Fiona is the kind of accidental sleuth you'll want riding shotgun, whether she's charming suspicious locals or untangling secrets older than the stone walls around her.

Future books in the series are also available!
